## Hello

This is the R implementation of the ETAIN Dose calculator.

## EMF Dose calculations

In general: dose = exposure duration * output power of device * SAR of tissue

# Which EMF sources are considered?

* Mobile calls
* Mobile data
* WiFi
* Laptop
* Tablet
* Cordless phone
* Far-field
* Other devices
